title: relay metrics is hidden from help and has no time window
what: Add `relay metrics` (summary, `<unit>`, `sweep`, `backfill`) to `relay help`; add a time window (`--since 6h|1d|<date>`, `--until`) and a bucket option (`--by hour|day|week`, default week) to the summary, so stage medians, gate time and cost per unit can be compared across buckets.
why: The owner asked for stage and gate times over the last hours and expected the new metrics command to answer; the front did not find it, because `relay help` does not list it, and the command only groups by ISO week, so "the last few hours" cannot be asked.
failing_case: 30 Oct 2026: `bin/relay help | grep -i metrics` prints nothing; `bin/relay metrics` prints only "2026-W44:" with one block for the whole week; no option narrows it to hours.
pass_cases: `relay help` lists every relay metrics form with one line each.
`relay metrics --since 12h --by hour` prints one block per hour with per-stage median and total, gate time, cost per unit; an empty hour prints a line saying so.
An unknown option is refused with the usage line, not a traceback.
dropped_why: Owner, 30 Oct: "У нас уже была задача на исправление команды help, должен быть встроенный механизм автоматического включения команды в help, так устроены все библиотеки для cli утилит". The help part belongs to every-new-relay-command-edits-bin-relay; the time window is filed again on its own as relay-metrics-has-no-time-window.

said: Я полагал что ты воспользуешься встроенным механизмом metrics, он должен отвечать на эти вопросы, он был введен совсем недавно и мне было интересно как он работает
